name: Why-us assistant tabs (four-part story block)
purpose: Makes the "why choose us" case in one sequence: pitch the assistant, show its roles, show the platform areas, then prove it with results and a big quote.
description: Four stacked blocks in one component (only /company/why-nimbus): (1) left-aligned balanced H2 with an italic phrase, grey intro and primary button; (2) a tab row above a loop slider of 5 slides (white lead-in + grey run-on copy, a 1:1 video placeholder bleeding right); (3) a split header (H2 | italic quote card with avatar) over split-layout tabs (large text tabs with green chip on the left, a fading screenshot pane bleeding right, per-tab paragraph + dark button); (4) centred results header with an italic word, a 4-up grid of stat cards (logo, big stat, sentence with the customer name as link), a big centred quote with stacked avatar and a primary CTA. <=991 results go 2-up and the split header stacks; <=767 the split tabs become a scrolling row over a 60dvh pane; <=479 cards are 1-up.
